author: Stahly
description:
The Emperor's Finest keep getting reinforcements. After the updated Custodian Guard and plastic grav-tanks, the Legio Custodes Support Battle Group brings more heavy hitters to the field: agile Gyrfalcon jetbikes, the compact but punchy Pallas Grav-Attack, and the imposing Telemon Heavy Dreadnought. In this review, we unbox all three kits, walk through every build option, and show you high-res sprue images alongside our full unboxing video.

The post Legio Custodes Support Battle Group review: gorgeous but complex builds appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Legio Custodes Support Battle Group review: gorgeous but complex builds
